QuestInfo.name: Getting to Know Your Bits: Bit-Cases
QuestInfo.1: Open the Bits window and equip a Bit-Case.
QuestInfo.2: Now you know how to open the Bits window and register a Bit-Case.

0.0: #b#e#h0##k#n!\r\nLemme tell you about the #e#rBits System#k#n. Why? Because it's so much fun! It's like a puzzle, except you get stat buffs. All you have to do is put the right Bits in your Bit-Case and you get a #eset effect#n... Why are your eyes glazing over? Pay attention!

yes.0: Use the #b#eBits button#k#n on the bottom of your inventory window or the #b#e[Bits] hotkey#k#n to open up the Bits window. #r#eDrag#n#k a #e#bBit-Case#k#n from your Set-up tab into the Bits window to get started. \r\n#i3800446#

1.0: Now it's time to equip some Bits.
1.1: Bits are sort of like equipment, but you'll find them in the #b#eBits tab#k#n instead of your Equip tab. Just #e#rdrag in#k#n Bits to equip them.\r\n#i3800448#
1.2: All Bits have stats, and you'll get set effects by equipping the entire set.\r\n#i3800447#
1.3: BUT, and here's the super fun part, Bits only fit in their designated slots, so you can't equip two identical pieces. It's easy to figure out where they go, because it'll make a neat little picture for you!\r\nSee? Try this one out. I WONDER WHAT IT IS!!

default.0: Use the #b#eBits button#k#n on the bottom of your inventory window or the #b#e[Bits] hotkey#k#n to open up the Bits window. #r#eDrag#n#k a #e#bBit-Case#k#n from your Set-up tab into the Bits window to get started. \r\n#i3800446#\r\nTry out that one I just gave you.
